subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Utilizar as diferentes linguagens, levando em conta seus funcionamentos, para a compreensão e produção de textos e discursos em diversos campos de atuação social.

components.description_pt: Identificar características funcionais de diferentes linguagens e modalidades
components.description_en: Identify the functional characteristics of different languages and modalities
components.cc_component_description: Identify characteristics of various text types and their communicative purposes

components.description_pt: Compreender textos em diversos campos de prática social usando modalidades de linguagem apropriadas
components.description_en: Comprehend texts across diverse social practice fields using appropriate language modalities
components.cc_component_description: Apply reading strategies to access complex informational texts across content areas

components.description_pt: Produzir textos em diversos campos selecionando linguagens e modalidades adequadas
components.description_en: Produce texts across diverse fields by selecting suitable languages and modalities
components.cc_component_description: Produce writing that is clear and coherent across development and organization

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend informational texts, including history/social studies, science, and technical texts, at the high end of the grades 4—5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development and organization are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* presentar o definir temas
* describir cómo funciona u ocurre algo
* agregar precisión y detalles
* exponer las características de textos y sus propósitos
* relacionar diferencias en una variedad de textos
